detail.longDescription: Working across time zones: I stopped doing mental arithmetic. I set world clocks in my Firefox new tab (Weather & Clock Dashboard) for EST, CET, and JST. After a few months of seeing those clocks every time I open a tab, I stopped making time zone errors almost entirely. Ambient beats on-demand for time zone awareness. https:// addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firef ox/addon/weather-clock-dashboard/ # RemoteWork # Productivity
